name: Solenne Mirrorpalm Spire Gala Glove
description:
Elbow-length evening gloves in liquid-mirror biosync fabric — a chromatic weave that shifts between platinum, champagne, and deep violet depending on ambient light and the wearer's body temperature signature. The surface catches gala lighting like pooled mercury. Seams are hand-finished with micro-filament edging; the inner lining is climate-regulated silk-analog that maintains skin temperature regardless of venue conditions.

Designed to cosmetically sleeve chrome arms — the biosync fabric drapes over augmented limbs with the same fluid fall as over biological ones. A discreet neural-port access slit runs along the inner wrist, closed by a magnetic micro-clasp.
functionality: Cosmetic chrome coverage — drapes naturally over aug arms. Neural-port access slit at inner wrist. Passive thermoregulation maintains comfort across venue temperature ranges. Biosync fabric responds to biometric data, subtly shifting color with the wearer's emotional state — a feature, not a flaw, at Spire events.
what_it_says: You wear wealth that moves, and your augmentations are not hidden — they are dressed.
worn_by: Tier 5 power brokers seeking cosmetic aug coverage
story_hooks: A pair appears at a Tier 2 Circuit market — the biosync fabric still active, still shifting — stripped from someone who attended a Spire gala and never came home.
The biometric color-shift feature has been reverse-engineered by a street lab to read emotional states accurately enough to use as a lie detector at close range.
A Spire diplomat's gloves shifted to deep crimson at the exact moment a corponation merger was announced — and three people in the room noticed.

physical_description.color_scheme: Platinum, champagne gold, and deep violet with iridescent color-shifting properties depending on light angle and wearer's thermal signature
physical_description.closures: Magnetic micro-clasp at inner wrist (neural-port access); otherwise seamless upper arm closure via precision fit
distinctive_features: Liquid-mirror biosync fabric with chromatic light-responsiveness
Discreet neural-port access slit along inner wrist
